resolvedQuestions.text: What exact two-backend amendments do 002, 003, 005 and 006 need?
resolvedQuestions.answer: Line map (002:3,49,86,92; 003:48,54,97,124-128; 005:91,105-109; 006:3,43,53,86,102-108), one replacement gate text, keep-rule deltas, six-step build order, and 006 takes no classifier.

resolvedQuestions.text: Which validator residue builds first as a slice?
resolvedQuestions.answer: Citation drift: 456 file:line citations, each a binary 'does line N support the claim' check in a sibling advisory. Deem preferred (local prose), label ~30 pairs, never a gate.

resolvedQuestions.text: What is the backend-neutral build order?
resolvedQuestions.answer: Step 0 spec text; step 1 six parallel zero-call artifacts (~1,500 LOC); step 2 cli-deem standalone leaf (~440); step 3 six gated arms in gate-cheapness order; step 4 extraction wave. Total ~2,600-3,100 LOC + 120 doc lines.

resolvedQuestions.text: What is the smallest cli-deem slice — wrapper, translator or client?
resolvedQuestions.answer: A thin stdlib client to POST /v1/systemone on the run path with an envelope translator to the Jev-shaped result (~180 LOC + fixtures). Wrapper rejected (custom-provider fails request build for choice/score and auth status lies); transparent provider rejected (field names asymmetric). Model id must be pinned to deem-0.8-v1.

resolvedQuestions.text: Does the custom provider make cli-deem a thin wrapper?
resolvedQuestions.answer: No. Typed subcommands fail at request build (criteria vs options/levels); audit status would report a dead server; the bearer is mandatory and ignored. Separate client verdict.

resolvedQuestions.text: Which reduction seams have headroom for a local call?
resolvedQuestions.answer: Advisor 2,200 ms internal under a 2,500 ms child kill; PreCompact 1,800 ms internal; routing CLIs no clock; PostToolUse 5-10 s without an output-rewrite contract. Only a shell-out spawns; a Node-native fetch costs connect + warm 60-80 ms.

resolvedQuestions.text: What exactly does 'Deem is available' mean?
resolvedQuestions.answer: GET /health within the probe budget; JSON parses; status ok; backend is torch or ensemble:* without stub; model == deem-0.8-v1. Four skip lines. Loading and update restarts read as not reachable.

resolvedQuestions.text: What prints and persists per backend failure, and what kills each survivor?
resolvedQuestions.answer: One combined table; no path returns a default; the no-behavior-change fixture proves byte-identical output and zero writes; four printed kill lines plus Deem's own; no averaging or failover on disagreement.

resolvedQuestions.text: What is the first PR-sized slice?
resolvedQuestions.answer: score-jev-tiebreak.mjs census slice only: ~180 LOC + ~120 vitest + ~20 spec lines; --jev answered by printed refusal; three pre-registered exits; rollback = git revert (REQ-006 read-only).

resolvedQuestions.text: Which flips survive contracts and callers?
resolvedQuestions.answer: Exactly one conditional flip: BASE1 row 1 under the Node-native path, gated by R1 keep and a measured connect+call p95 with the advisor's compiled-route work in place; rows 5/38/40 and the grok-04 set do not flip.

resolvedQuestions.text: What is the counted blast radius of moving cli-jev under cli-classifier?
resolvedQuestions.answer: 92 files / 927 occurrences; nine surface classes; the seven-hub guard list, tri-state flag list and dispatch shape table are literals; an alias cannot carry a metadata hub; five-step skeleton-first plan.

resolvedQuestions.text: What does cli-classifier look like as files?
resolvedQuestions.answer: A normal parent hub: SKILL.md/README.md/ROUTER.md/description.json/graph-metadata.json/mode-registry.json/hub-router.json/leaf-manifest.json + cli-usage and cli-deem modes. No third tier, no global switch. Move = 53 files / 39 refs / 12 generated surfaces, atomic.

resolvedQuestions.text: What does deem-ctl already cover and what are its gaps?
resolvedQuestions.answer: Full start/stop/status/update/rollback with exit 0-4 and prune-to-two checkpoints; gaps: no model pin in its health rule, no smoke on a stopped-server update, no wait-for-exit after kill.

resolvedQuestions.text: Does a live Deem seam need a warm server, and does precompute help?
resolvedQuestions.answer: Warm or skip; the host session.compact precompute contract exists with a still-leads stale rule, but no repo dispatch without a plugin; a background pass is the only live compaction home.

Contract now, file at the third BUILT caller (row 27 applied: 0 built, 2 designed-certain, 3 gated). Home: .skilled/bin/backend-probe.cjs. Per-process memo only — cross-run cache is wrong because deem-ctl updates swap weights.

resolvedQuestions.text: Where do sk-prompt and sk-design routers admit a classifier?
resolvedQuestions.answer: Their INTENT_MODEL scorers are embedded pseudocode executed by the main model; a deterministic port precedes any classifier. The only live-shaped arm is on the zero-score fallback class, behind per-feature switches and an ambiguity corpus.

resolvedQuestions.text: What is the top counted context-reduction seam?
resolvedQuestions.answer: The 005 offline compaction census (226 boundaries, ~104 s p50 each). Census first, stop line printed, deletion arm as amendment only if it clears; a live PreCompact classifier is refused (1.8 s budget, deadline-driven).

resolvedQuestions.text: Can a classifier cut work in the resource-routing layer?
resolvedQuestions.answer: Bounded only: compiled routing is authoritative behind flag+manifest+policy-hash gates and cli-jev's ROUTER.md is stage1-only. The slice is an offline leaf-route replay runner over existing canary corpora, plus a bounded tie-break arm — never a replacement.

resolvedQuestions.text: Which validator checks leave a judgment residue?
resolvedQuestions.answer: All 40 rules mapped; six approximate meaning with patterns; AC_COVERAGE never verifies a cited line exists; check-goal.cjs's four checks leave binding scope, hollow prose, measurability and kept-content residues.

keyFindings.text: No auth; CORS * on every answer; any local process or open page can answer the probe.
Deem /health is a pure dict read; stub passes status alone; only backend+model prove the served weights.
Deem and Jev wire shapes are asymmetric; the thin client + envelope translator is the smallest honest path; model pin required (deem-0.8-v1).
Line-level amendment map and one replacement gate text for all four Planned phases; 006 takes no classifier.
First PR = census slice only; stub-silence test is the cross-backend audit template; movable prices both backends; revert-clean.
The served commit pair lives only in deem-ctl status; /health has no commit; records must carry the pair.
A stopped-server update switches the model without a smoke decision; start validates liveness only.
16 checks across six validator tools + five naming scripts; residues are silent fallback, frontmatter content, severity asymmetry, DQI hollowness, citation drift.
AC_COVERAGE counts file:line presence, never checks the citation exists; a no-model fix is available.
Compiled serving is gated by flag + servingAuthority + exact policyHash/generation; cli-jev ROUTER.md is stage1-only; RESOURCE_MAP selects resources after mode selection.
Advisor 3000/2500/2200 with {} fail-open; PreCompact 1800 internal with skip-on-exhaustion; routing CLIs have no clock.
005's census prints the stop line before any arm; live PreCompact classifier refused on the 1.8 s budget; vendored compact.ts supplies the two-noul-per-call arm blueprint.
The advisor already shells out to compiled-route.cjs inside its own budget; any added call competes with it.
sk-prompt/sk-design routers are embedded INTENT_MODEL pseudocode scored by the main model; deterministic port first; zero-score fallback is the only live-shaped arm.
auth status --provider custom exits 0 with a key and no server; it must never be the Deem check.
No guard refuses loopback/plain-HTTP endpoints; the recorded matrix sent http://127.0.0.1:9 with a sentinel key.
456 file:line citations, binary per-pair judgment, advisory sibling script, Deem-preferred, byte-identical fallback with neither backend.
Hub move touches 92 files / 927 refs; compiled-routing and dispatch literals are pinned; an alias cannot carry a metadata hub.
cli-classifier is a normal two-mode parent hub; the move is a counted 53-file atomic job; hub root cannot host helpers (OVERLAY_FILES={}).
Host precompute keeps its result only if the conversation still leads — the staleness rule a background pass mirrors.
Probe contract: independent parallel probes (Deem allowlist+pin; Jev REQ-002), 2 s/500 ms budgets, per-process memo, aligned skip lines; extraction at third built caller into .skilled/bin/.
The proof that neither backend changes today's behavior is a dead-backend fixture asserting byte-identical output and zero writes.
Five-step dependency order; cli-deem leaf precedes the hub (contests deepseek-10); 'deem arm stopped: server gone' added; ~2,600-3,100 LOC total.
